GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 1.5 Lengths Two Wide , held together much same to turn then Hooked Out to 2 Lengths 3 Wide , kept trying but gave up a length running down the Straight # battled on fairly

Jumped in the air as gates opened, missed start 4 Lengths and Settled Down Out Of Picture , tacked on as they started the turn, trailed 8 Lengths Two Wide rounding turn, picked up a length and a half in straight. [Stewards: Reared as start was effected and trailed the field until the 600m, Further barrier certificate required.] # Blew the start
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Reared as the start was effected and lost considerable ground. Trailed the field until near the 600m. Further barrier cert prior to racing again.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly then Went Forward to lead on fence by a head, Held Together in front and led by inches turning, drifted 3 Wide late on turn then Dropped Out in straight. [Stewards questioned rider re performance. App. jockey had no explanation for it weakening considerably in straight. Stewards further questioned her riding approaching/rounding the home turn. She explained the stable opinion and hers, was that the better part of the track was away from the rail in straight. Trainer could not explain the performance and advise it would be spelled.] # weak once headed
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Near 300m shifted out & bumped. Rdr had no explanation for performance of mare which weakened considerably in straight. When quest re riding approaching & round h/turn, Rdr explained view of connections, better part of track in h/straight was away from rail, so near 300m, allowed mount to shift out to get away from rail. Tnr confirmed instructs & re-affirmed belief best going was away from rail in straight. Rdr agreed in hindsight it would have been best to have maintained position rather than shifting out. Tnr unable to explain performance & mare going for spell.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down 4th 1x1 3 Lengths only 1 Lengths off winner, Straightening Up in between runners and 5th then was Under Pressure @ 300m couldn't finish off - # had its chance

Jumped well and Went Forward to 2 Lengths Lead on fence, Held Together in front & led 1 length turning, got away rounding turn and led 2 Lengths Straightening Up , kept going in Straight easing down final 40-or-50m. # won easing down

Jumped okay & Settled Down 1.5 Lengths Two Wide , moved to within 0.75 Lengths turning, failed to respond when pressured rounding turn and Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards: Post-race vet exam revealed lameness in the off foreleg. Vet clearance required.] # Pulled up lame.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race vet exam revealed lameness in the off foreleg. Vet clearance prior to racing again.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to a half length Lead on fence, Held Together in front & led 0.75 Lengths turning, got away Straightening Up and kept going to post # led/solid win

Jumped Fast Ridden Along from Outside hence 6 Wide early steadied Settled Down 3 Wide 3rd 1 Lengths Good Pace on, had no favours Out On A Limb to Straightening Up Couldn'T Go On @ 300m, # had no favours
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide throughout. Laid in under pressure over the concluding stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped best and Went Forward to 2.5 Lengths joint Lead on fence, Held Together in front & led 1 length turning, got away rounding turn, led 2 Lengths or better Straightening Up then kicked clear down the running, eased up on the line # dominant win
Jumped well balanced up Outside Leader (800m), Took over into the Straight couldn't get away though, faded # pace/had chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out under pressure near the 200m. After race noted to have lost its near hind plate.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 2nd on fence trailing a head, shifted Two Wide mid-race and moved up to Two Wide joint Lead turning, sole Lead Straightening Up , Headed 160m, kept trying to finish. [Stewards: Raced keenly middle stages.] # battled on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Raced keenly in the middle stages. Lost the off-hind plate in the running.
